scope: LONGHORN-48 V2 on-demand snapshot checksum integration; not corruption detection, all-data rehash or complete acceptance
conclusions: Volume.Spec.snapshotHashingRequestedAt and Status.lastOnDemandSnapshotHashingCompleteAt identify asynchronous requests. The website final completion paragraph uses an incorrect alternate field; pinned API and controller define the authoritative spelling.

The controller acknowledges when all relevant existing user snapshots have a checksum; node events enqueue only user snapshots missing checksums. Existing checksums do not prove this request reread all snapshot data.
checksumCalculatedAt updates only when checksum changes or is initially written. A previously hashed snapshot need not advance its timestamp for a successful new request.

At least two RW replicas and enabled/fast-check policy are required. fast-check cannot establish detection of filesystem-unaware bit rot; enabled periodic hashing increases IO. Do not overlap purge, rebuild, restore or migration.

Qualify the documented native CR operation only after config+kubecli native/CSI snapshots and independent restore boundaries. Limit per-volume fast-check to the disposable owned source, UID/RV/spec-test the patch, retain global policy identities, and verify cross-node source data before UID-scoped cleanup.

Official snapshot hashing performance figures use historical Kubernetes v1.24.4+rke2r1, AWS c5d.2xlarge and NVMe/st1 disks. They explain IO cost but are not V2 1.12.1 sizing, throughput or SLA evidence.

V2 hashes SPDK snapshot lvol ranges; rehash=false reuses an existing checksum. Its fixed SnapshotHashStatus leaves historical silentlyCorrupted detection disabled; Manager cross-replica checksum comparison remains a different mechanism. Do not infer V1 filesystem/mtime behavior or universal bit-rot repair for V2.
project_entrypoint: config.yml + kubecli setup DEPLOYMENT 09, then documented UID-bound native Volume CR checksum request
classification: test-gate plus documented native operation; no new product configuration API
coverage_boundary: Does not complete V1 corruption/isolation export LONGHORN-30, V2 corruption detection, periodic full rehash, DR/SystemRestore or complete LONGHORN-48.
